headline: European AI is in a capital-concentrated boom, with mega-rounds led by Mistral, Helsing and Agile Robots. Finnish firms use AI at about twice the EU rate, and the main Horizon Europe Apply AI calls have been open since 2026-11-17.

signals.title: Horizon Europe Apply AI, data and robotics calls open
signals.detail: The main AI, data and robotics topics opened 2026-11-17 and close 2027-03-18. They include DIGITAL-EMERGING-04, -05, -06 (international cooperation in AI) and -11, plus DATA-03, DATA-08 and DATA-09.

signals.title: Stoa raises €3.5m pre-seed (Helsinki, construction AI)
signals.detail: Round led by Lifeline Ventures, per a secondary news site. Amount and lead not checked against the company.

signals.title: Intergrid raises €23.5m in total funding
signals.detail: Helsinki startup building an autopilot for industrial energy operations. Round co-led by Kvanted and Tesi, with €2.7m from Business Finland.

signals.title: Daisytuner (Germany) raises €6m seed for chip-agnostic AI inference
signals.detail: Co-led by Elaia and LEA Ventures, with Amadeus APEX Technology Fund and Seedcamp. An AI-powered compiler plus runtime that adapts models to NVIDIA, AMD and other chips. Shows investor appetite for inference-efficiency software, an area close to university compiler and ML systems research.

signals.title: Treat (Finland) raises €3m pre-seed for AI patient intake
signals.detail: Finnish healthtech using AI for patient intake in private healthcare; round led by byFounders and Illusian. Amount and investors are from a Tech.eu headline and search summary; the article itself was not read in full.

signals.title: Agile Robots raises $500m Series F at $8.5bn
signals.detail: Munich robotics company; round led by SoftBank with NVIDIA and Hitachi.

signals.title: EuroHPC AI Gigafactories call closed
signals.detail: Call for up to seven sites with up to €10bn public funding. Selection is due in early 2027 (secondary sources).

signals.title: European startup funding reportedly fell 62% in October
signals.detail: €6bn across 288 rounds versus €15.8bn in September. Single aggregator, all sectors, so indicative only.

signals.title: EIC 2027 calls start opening
signals.detail: EIC Accelerator 2027 short-proposal submission opened on 2026-11-10 (portal lists a final date of 2027-12-16). EIC STEP Scale Up opens 2026-11-18 (€290m, equity of €10m to €30m) and EIC Pathfinder Open opens 2026-11-25 (€166m, about 45 grants; portal dates 2027-02-25 and 2027-09-16).

signals.title: EuroHPC AI Gigafactories tender closes 2026-11-12
signals.detail: The tender is for up to seven AI gigafactories, with awards expected in early 2027. This is a reported item from an aggregator; verify before use.

signals.title: Saidot raises new round to expand in the US
signals.detail: AI governance platform; led by BackingMinds with Crowberry Capital and Ventic. Amount undisclosed.

signals.title: Aalto ranks third in Europe for university spinout funding (H1 2026)
signals.detail: Aalto ranked behind Oxford and Cambridge. It aims to raise spin-offs from historically 0–5 a year to as many as 25 a year by 2030. The Aalto Startup Center name is being retired. The date is the update date, because the article's publication date was not shown.

signals.title: October 2026 European seed rounds: Machenta $40m, Rivercell $25m
signals.detail: Machenta (London) is building robot-learning models that learn from a single demonstration. Vestbee's list is mixed, so treat it as indicative.

signals.title: European Q3 VC rebound
signals.detail: €13.7bn raised across 1,300+ rounds, the best quarter since Q2 2024, led by growth rounds. The date is the quarter end.

signals.title: Finland H1 2026 tech funding review
signals.detail: About €1.3bn across 53 deals, with space dominant. AI infrastructure Verda ($117m), Qutwo (€25m) and Capalo AI (€11m) were the main AI-related rounds.

signals.title: Mistral AI raises €3bn Series D
signals.detail: Samsung-led round at about €21bn post-money, reported by Euronews and EUACC.

signals.title: Mistral AI raises €3bn Series D
signals.detail: Reported as Europe's largest AI round, at a valuation above €21bn. The month comes from a September report, so the exact date is approximate.

signals.title: AI Act Digital Omnibus in force
signals.detail: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 delays high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 (Annex III) and 2028-08-02 (Annex I). New Article 5 bans apply from 2026-12-02.
